title: Rabbi Unia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 2, on verse 7; in Kohelet Rabbah, on “I, Kohelet,” together with Rabbi Yudan; and in Midrash Tehillim 1:18: Rabbi Unia said, “Just as water is used for gardens,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: לגנות means “for gardens,” not “to be disgraced.” The consulted Midrash Tehillim has the water/gardens comparison at 1:16; Hyman cites 1:18.

The complete Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:7 scalar names Rabbi Onya, and the complete Kohelet Rabbah 1:12 scalar names Rabbi Yudan and Rabbi Onyah (אוניה). The complete Midrash Tehillim 1:16 scalar has Rabbi Unia and water used for gardens and orchards; Hyman cites 1:18. The forms and locators remain distinct, without a new identity resolution.
